### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A01 was not observed at all (0 of 200 traces); in the later window it appears exactly once in every trace (100% participation, mean 1.0 occurrence per trace), at a late relative position (median 0.8, mean 0.76 of the trace length). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the earlier window A08 occurred in every trace while A01 never did; in the later window both occur in every trace, and A01 always precedes A08. [REL004]
- Routing shifted into A01: before, A04's outgoing transitions went mainly to A08 (about 60%) and A09's mainly to A08 (about 69%); in the later window A04 leads mainly to A01 (about 88%) and A09 mainly to A01 (about 91%). A01's own outgoing transitions go to A08 (72.5%), A07 (17%) and A06 (10.5%). [DIR002, DIR003, DIR001]
- The step distance from the predecessors to A08 grew by about one: A04→A08 was 1 step in 60% of observations (2 steps in 40%) before and 2–3 steps (51% and 49%) after; A09→A08 was 1 step in 69% before and 2–3 steps (74% and 26%) after. [LAG003, LAG007]
- A04 and A09 always precede A01 when they occur with it; A06 and A07 usually precede A01 but in a minority of later traces follow it (A07 before A01 in 36.5% of traces vs 17% the other way; A06 before in 36% vs 10.5%). [REL001, REL005, REL003, REL002]
- A04 and A09 sit slightly earlier in later traces (mean relative position 0.65→0.50 and 0.74→0.62), and the gaps between A04/A09 and A06/A07 and between A06/A07 and A08 shifted to larger step distances; some of these pairs rest on few observations (11–33). [POS002, POS003, LAG001, LAG002, LAG006, LAG004, LAG005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The 19 qualifying items (all control-flow) far exceed the roughly 0.18 expected for an unchanged process, so the set as a whole cannot be explained by chance sampling. The evidence directly and consistently supports one hypothesis: in the later window a new activity, A01, was threaded into the flow between A04/A09 and A08. A01, unobserved in the earlier window, now runs once per trace at a late position; A04 and A09, which previously led mainly to A08, now lead mainly to A01; A01 always precedes A08 and leads to it in about 72% of its outgoing transitions; and the step distance from A04/A09 to A08 grew by about one step, as expected if one activity now sits between them. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, REL004, LAG003, LAG007]

Limitations: the placement of A01 relative to A06 and A07 is not fixed — those activities usually precede A01 but occasionally follow it — and the widened gaps among A04/A09, A06/A07 and A08 are consistent with the same insertion but do not pin down a single insertion point. Zero participation in the earlier window strictly means only that A01 was not observed there; an extremely rare pre-existing A01 missed by the 200 earlier traces cannot be fully excluded, though 0 occurrences in 200 traces makes that unlikely. [REL002, REL003, LAG001, LAG002, LAG006, LAG004, LAG005, OCC001]
